name: Parliament ~Koukinaru Mono to no Nichijou~
original_name: Parliament ～高貴なるモノとの日常～
source:
This is a collection of photos and the thoughts I had while taking them.
The story isn’t particularly long—the file size is large because the entire text is narrated aloud.

Ever wonder what goes through the mind of someone wandering alone? Or how someone else sees the world?
This might give you a glimpse into the mundane, everyday life of a stranger.
Whether there’s a demand for this kind of thing, I don’t know.

If you’re into landscape photography, you might enjoy just looking at the scenery.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/3315]freem[/url]]
translation:
这是一部将照片与我拍摄时的所思所想汇集而成的作品。
故事本身并不算长，文件体积之所以比较大，是因为全文都配有朗读语音。

你可曾好奇过独自漫步的人脑海里在想些什么？或是别人眼中的世界是什么模样？
这部作品或许能让你一窥某个陌生人平淡无奇的日常生活。
至于这种东西有没有人想看，我就不得而知了。

如果你喜欢风景摄影，或许光是欣赏其中的景致也能乐在其中。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/3315]freem[/url]]
